prompt:
Deliverable: one painterly dark gothic anime character-design master image of a single character, the whole body from the top of the hair to the soles of the boots, standing, portrait 2:3, one image only. It is the identity anchor for later art; reference images are numbered below.
SUBJECT: Mahmut, an adult man aged 28, tall and broad-shouldered, about seven and a half heads tall, a weathered former sworn palace guard. Draw exactly the face, short dark messy hair, stubble, brown tired-but-steady eyes and composed closed-mouth expression of the man in reference image 1. He wears dark worn half-plate repaired in several mismatched styles by village smiths: steel gorget, breastplate, layered pauldrons, vambraces, a belt with small pouches, dark charcoal cloth below the breastplate with a torn hem, dark greaves and plain dark boots, and scarred, scuffed gloves. A small Crown Guard star is mounted on the centre of the breastplate; directly above it is a small empty hammered-out socket, bare roughened plate with nothing mounted in it, where a crown once sat. A tattered oxblood cloak, Guard red dyed darker into a deep brownish crimson, hangs from his shoulders behind him with bold ragged torn edges and never covers the front of the armour, his arms, the sword or the shield. In his right hand, on the left side of the picture, he holds an arming sword lowered, its blade angled toward the ground and slightly away from his body: plain straight guard, plain grip, and a pommel with a flat dull iron disc filling a round crest socket. On his left forearm, on the right side of the picture, a repaired dark heater shield is strapped and worn low at his side with its face turned slightly toward the viewer: plain dark face, bevelled iron rim, visible riveted repairs, a leather strap, and a tiny abstract round seal impression pressed into the rim, with no heraldry or crest on the face. No helmet, no raised hood.
COMPOSITION: neutral relaxed standing pose, weight slightly on one leg, loose shoulders, calm closed-mouth expression; the body turned about 30 degrees toward the left of the frame, the face turned slightly more, eyes to the camera. The whole figure fits inside the frame: top of the hair about 5% below the top edge, the soles of both boots about 6% above the bottom edge, at least 8% margin at left and right including cloak, sword and shield; the eye line is about 11% from the top. Both hands, the sword and the shield are fully visible and unobstructed, each hand drawn with five clear fingers, and the planted boots are the lowest point of the figure with nothing beneath them.
STYLE: painterly dark gothic anime light-novel illustration, detailed face and hair, thin soft plum-black linework slightly heavier on the outer silhouette, soft cel shading on the skin in two to three value steps, painterly gradients on matte cloth, weathered worn dull metal, visible brush grain and paper tooth, no gloss.
LIGHT AND PALETTE: cool slate ambient light (#3B434D family) on the face and armour; one thin warm amber rim light (#D9A441) from behind on the left side of the frame, tracing the hair, the jaw and the pauldron edge so the dark silhouette separates from the background; charcoal steel, ash, a tattered cloak in oxblood (lit mid-tone #6B1E2C, shadow #371C21); restrained low saturation, darkest value #0F0D11, never pure black.
TECHNICAL: flat pure #00FF00 background, one flat colour from edge to edge with no gradient, floor line, cast shadow, glow or mist; crisp hard silhouette edges; no green anywhere on the subject, no green reflections or green rim light; the hair outline is made of thick clumped locks with no thin flyaway strands; text-free.
Do not add: text, letters, logos, watermark, border, a second person, a helmet, a raised hood, a crown, a royal crest, a bright red cloak, modern items, extra fingers, extra limbs.
